card.title: Confess Around Them
card.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 admits changing time and probes room; A3 calls it half; A5 seeks B's matching responsibility after conceding notice.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 time surprise prompts A3 half-failure; B4 no notice prompts A5 concession followed by reciprocal demand.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 hold A to account rather than obediently providing a confession.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 legitimate criticism to complete A's admission and make B's the outstanding half.
